extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) 'species' and 'island' columns had case/space variants that were normalized; (2) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas and needed conversion to numeric; (3) two rows had body mass values (3,950,000 and 4,725,000 grams) far outside the valid range [2500, 6500] grams and were excluded. After fixes, the total body mass for each species is: Adelie: 77,150 grams, Chinstrap: 32,775 grams, Gentoo: 96,850 grams.
